comments.text: It’s such a beautiful video. I will also add that the Congo River flows/borders three countries Congo, DR Congo and Angola and the Nile spread across 11 countries Egypt, Sudan, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Uganda, Tanzania, Kenya, Rwanda, Burundi, DR Congo and Eritrea. Also the maps of the countries for the Congo River and the Nile were also left out. Good video though.
